title: Open Source Voxel World
author: Free_Afternoon_7349
selftext:
Would love to hear what features or upgrades y'all would do to this voxel world. 

code: [https://github.com/samuelahmed/voxel-world-template](https://github.com/samuelahmed/voxel-world-template)
